full_prompt_en: A square vintage-toned fashion photograph shows a seated woman in sunglasses among dry rocks beneath a deep turquoise sky. The sky fills the upper half with uneven teal color, fine film grain, and faint scratches, while pale scrub and rounded stones form a low horizon behind her. At the left edge, a large weathered rock catches a muted yellow highlight; smaller rough stones lead toward the center and right. The woman sits near the middle with her bare knees rising into the lower foreground. Her dark, softly waved hair falls around the ears, and large dark lenses conceal her eyes. Her head tips slightly upward toward the left, giving her face a contemplative, sunward angle. A loose peach and cream garment wraps around her shoulders and arms, its open front showing a smaller patterned layer at the chest. The fabric gathers in relaxed folds at her lap, where her forearms cross loosely. Her skin is rendered in warm amber and brown shadows rather than neutral photographic color. Golden sunlight from the upper left lifts the bridge of her nose, shoulder, forearms, and knees; the underside of the chin and folds of the clothing fall into dense shadow. The ground is coarse and dry, with patches of straw-colored vegetation at the bottom and along the right. Across the photograph, chemical-looking color shifts push the cyan sky against ochre earth and orange-red skin. Fine dust, faded edges, uneven exposure, and occasional pale marks make the frame resemble an aged analog print. No readable lettering appears in the selected image. The overall composition is low and intimate, balancing a calm central pose with wide open color above and sun-baked texture below.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形复古色调时尚照片呈现一位戴太阳镜的女子，坐在干燥岩石间，头顶是深青绿天空。天空占据上半幅，青绿色不均匀，带有细胶片颗粒和淡淡划痕；身后浅色灌丛与圆石构成低矮地平线。左边缘的大块风化岩石受到暗黄色高光照亮，较小的粗糙石块向中央和右侧延伸。女子坐在中部附近，裸露的膝盖伸入下方前景。深色柔波卷发落在耳边，宽大的深色镜片遮住眼睛。她的头微微向左上仰起，面部呈沉思般迎向阳光的角度。宽松的桃色与奶油色衣料包裹肩膀和手臂，敞开的前襟露出胸前较小的花纹内层。布料在腿上松弛地堆褶，前臂轻轻交叠。肤色呈暖琥珀色与棕色阴影，而非中性的照片色彩。来自左上方的金色日光提亮鼻梁、肩、前臂和膝盖；下巴底部与衣褶落入浓影。地面粗糙干燥，底部和右侧散有稻草色植被。整张照片中的化学显色感让青色天空与赭色土地、橙红肤色相互碰撞。细尘、褪色边缘、不匀曝光和零星淡痕使画面像一张老化的模拟照片。选定画面没有可读文字。整体构图低而亲近，以平静的中央姿态平衡上方宽阔的色域与下方曝晒过的肌理。
style_prompt_en: Analog-looking color photography uses heavy teal and cyan shadows against sun-warmed amber, ochre, and faded coral highlights. The palette feels chemically shifted rather than naturalistic: cool broad fields press against smaller hot areas, creating vivid tension without clean modern saturation. Strong directional sunlight gives exposed forms bright, slightly bleached planes and deep brown shadow pockets. Grain, fine scratches, dusty haze, and irregular fading remain visible across both smooth and rough areas, making the print surface an active part of the image. Edges are soft from exposure and age, yet major contours stay legible through value contrast. The frame favors an intimate low viewpoint, open upper space, and coarse detail near the lower edge. Color bleeds subtly into neighboring tones instead of ending at perfect digital boundaries. The overall effect is languid and cinematic, with heat, age, and imperfect processing carried by the color itself.
style_prompt_zh: 这类模拟胶片质感的彩色摄影以浓重青绿和青色阴影对照阳光烘暖的琥珀、赭色与褪珊瑚色亮部。配色带化学偏色感而非自然写实：宽阔冷色域挤压较小的热色区域，不依赖干净的现代高饱和度也形成鲜明张力。强烈定向阳光让受光形体呈稍稍漂白的亮面，凹处留下深棕影。颗粒、细划痕、尘雾和不规则褪色同时留在平滑与粗糙区域，使相纸表面成为图像的主动部分。边缘因曝光与年代感而柔化，主要轮廓仍靠明度反差清晰可辨。构图偏爱亲近的低视点、开放的上部空间和靠下缘的粗糙细节。颜色轻轻渗入相邻色调，而不以完美的数字边界结束。整体效果慵懒而有电影感，热度、年代和不完美冲洗感由颜色本身承载。
theme_en: A sunlit seated woman in sunglasses among dry rocks
theme_zh: 一位戴太阳镜的女子坐在阳光下的干燥岩石间
name: Neil Krug
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
